groups.title: KnowLine-31B-Gen1.5 · DGX Spark gets the most English reading questions right of the decision models

blocks.p: KnowLine-31B-Gen1.5 DGX Spark answered 512 of the 547 questions right (93.6%).

Against each of the 78 other decision models in the paired test (Holm-adjusted): 11 are too close to call (Copernicus-31B, REAX 1.3, KnowLine-31B-Gen2, Karpo Decision 31B, Gemini Decision 1 20261111 , Logits Sigma-1 Duo, GLiDE 27B DGX Spark , d1-ultra, Perplexity Decider 27B v1.2 API · with web , GLiDE v1.2 , d1.2-ultra); the other 67 got fewer right.

groups.title: In English, the best chat models get more questions right than any decision model

blocks.p: Right answers of the 547 questions: the best chat model, Claude Fable 5.2 max · chat , 536 (98.0%); the best decision model, KnowLine-31B-Gen1.5 DGX Spark , 512 (93.6%). 23 of the 84 chat model setups got more right than KnowLine-31B-Gen1.5 DGX Spark .
No test on the site compares a chat model with a decision model, so these gaps are counted, not tested.

groups.title: With “I don't know” offered in English, d1.2-ultra holds back a wrong answer most often

blocks.p: With an “I don't know” option in English, it chose it for 109 of its 122 answers that were not right (89.3%), and got 425 of 547 right (77.7%), against 510 for KnowLine-31B-Gen1.5 DGX Spark , the most accurate decision model with that run.
Next of the 79 decision models with that run: celeris-1.1-decision, 74.8%, with 416 right (76.1%).

groups.title: In English, among setups that score above chance (20%) with “I don't know” offered, a few decision models choose it over a wrong answer far more often than any chat model; the typical one does not

blocks.p: The best chat setup, Claude Fable 5.2 max · chat , reaches 28.6%; 16 of the 77 decision models with an “I don't know” option in English are above it, led by d1.2-ultra at 89.3%.
The median non-hallucination rate is 8.2% for the decision models and 7.4% for the 79 chat model setups.

Left out: Laya Multilingual (208 “I don't know”, 59 right), Laya (83 “I don't know”, 97 right), SmolLM2-360M-Instruct default reasoning · chat · HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-360M-Instruct@a10cc1512eabd3dde888204e902eca88bddb4951 (502 “I don't know”, 3 right), GLiNER2.5 Multi (92 “I don't know”, 77 right), SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct default reasoning · chat · HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct@31b70e2e869a7173562077fd711b654946d38674 (1 “I don't know”, 0 right): at or below chance (20.0%) with the option offered.

groups.title: A 12B open model on one GPU gets 86.8% of the English reading questions

blocks.p: Gemma 4 12B Unified default reasoning · chat answered 475 of 547 right, the best of the 16 small open chat models run in English only.
78 of all 169 English setups got more right; the best got 536 (98.0%).

groups.title: From a page picture alone, models score 13.6 points lower than from the text

blocks.p: Averaged over 20 image models. Vision's questions are original Turkish page images; the Vision tab has every result. The average covers the decision models only; the Vision tab shows the three chat models apart.
